{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue and filter out QA and refunded orders
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
completed_only = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Verify that 'converted' is 1 for all completed orders
print('Check: all completed orders have converted=1:', (completed_only['converted'] == 1).all())

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to check for confounding
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', pd.crosstab(completed_only['channel'], completed_only['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by channel and segment:\n', conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Extract the conversion rates for each group
email_loyal = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc['email', 'loyal']
email_new = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc['email', 'new']
email_returning = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc['email', 'returning']

paid_search_loyal = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc['paid_search', 'loyal']
paid_search_new = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc['paid_search', 'new']
paid_search_returning = conversion_by_channel_segment.loc['paid_search', 'returning']

# Compute stratified differences
diff_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal
diff_new = email_new - paid_search_new
diff_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning

print('\nStratified differences (email - paid_search):')
print(f'  loyal: {diff_loyal}')
print(f'  new: {diff_new}')
print(f'  returning: {diff_returning}')

# Compute segment counts
segment_counts = completed_only['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print('\nSegment counts in completed_only:')
print(f'  loyal: {segment_counts["loyal"]}')
print(f'  new: {segment_counts["new"]}')
print(f'  returning: {segment_counts["returning"]}')

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (diff_loyal * segment_counts['loyal'] + 
                  diff_new * segment_counts['new'] + 
                  diff_returning * segment_counts['returning']) / segment_counts.sum()

print('\nWeighted difference (email - paid_search):', weighted_diff)

# Final value for submission
print('\nFinal value:', weighted_diff)"}
